notes: Tapo cameras use a dedicated 'camera account' (separate from the Tapo cloud account) with username 'admin' and a password set in the Tapo app. Both must be 6–32 characters. Default RTSP port is 554. Full URL form: rtsp://{user}:{pass}@{ip}:{port}/stream1. Dual-lens models expose /stream6 (telephoto main) and /stream7 (telephoto sub). Only single-lens paths (/stream1, /stream2) apply universally.
